name: MovieSeriesTracker - Local-First TMDB Data App
objective: Build a local-first web app that syncs all TMDB data to a local database and provides a bilingual Thai/English UI for browsing movies, TV series, and people with personal tracking features
exit_criteria: Prisma schema covers ALL TMDB fields (movies, TV, seasons, episodes, person, genres, keywords, watch providers, collections, companies, networks, credits)
Data ingestion service syncs all data from TMDB with rate limiting
Next.js UI displays complete data for movies, series, and persons
Full-text search works across all entities
User can annotate watch status, ratings, notes, and watchlists
Bilingual Thai/English UI works throughout the app
PWA offline support works after initial data sync
Docker Compose setup works for local development
App can be deployed to Vercel
